requirements: R1: Address HTTP 401 rejections on endpoints that must answer 200/201 to resolve CI failures.
R2: Ensure pipeline validation properly rejects non-existent PR approvals.
R3: Implement automatic access control based on Moodle departments and courses.
R4: Assign the mapped internalRole from Moodle to the user and synchronize it to the database.
R5: Implement proper fallback logic to handle Moodle SSO server failures instead of suppressing test errors.
R6: Ensure methodological compliance by validating review verdicts against observable diff changes.

slices.title: Resolve Self-Falsification Audit Findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the resolution of self-falsification findings for this epic, I want to fix the root causes of the CI failures, SSO integration, and access controls, so that the CI pipeline passes and the product complies with the audit.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a request to endpoints that must answer 200/201, When authorized, Then the application answers with 200/201 instead of 401.
Given a Moodle SSO login, When the internalRole is mapped, Then it is assigned to the user and synchronized to the database.
Given a server failure during Moodle SSO, When the fallback logic is triggered, Then the application handles it gracefully without a 500 error.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero remaining self-falsification findings in the CI pipeline

slices.title: Verify Self-Falsification Audit Resolutions
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA verification for this epic, I want to comprehensively test the fixes for SSO, access control, and endpoint responses, so that the self-falsification findings are proven to be resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the updated endpoints and SSO integration, When integration and E2E tests are executed, Then they verify the 200/201 responses, internal role synchronization, and server failure fallbacks.
Given the Moodle access control logic, When tested with various departments and courses, Then access is correctly restricted.
Given the CI pipeline, When the test suite runs, Then all 15 previously failing tests pass successfully.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Test suite execution and coverage validation
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% test pass rate for the resolved findings
